scope: Only the product per-file qualification command split and its new test; previously reviewed snapshot changes are excluded. No test/native/build/DB/auth/network execution or private data access.
rationale: The only behavioral delta adds product alongside application in suite_patterns. It returns every already discovered test filename in the same sorted per-directory inventory; other suites and the sixteen focused commands are unchanged.
Shared source_commands and generic run_qualification both consume suite_patterns. The owning producer/freezer therefore use the same committed mapping interface already established for application.

No deadline changes are present. Generic execution still passes the existing timeout_seconds into ResourceLimits and retains the same wait/owned reaping checks; this split changes command boundaries, not per-command limits, failure/skip policy or financial rules.

The new regression checks exact product pattern order and absence of the old wildcard command. The existing complete-inventory regression also verifies every discovered test file is covered exactly once in phase2.
Generic report commands retain the actual pattern, unique ordinal log names, actual counts, source-after identity and reaping facts. Multiple product rows do not overwrite one another.
limitations: Static source inventory currently lists30 product test files; no unittest discovery or case execution was performed by the reviewer.
Method-level executed ID/order equality and the new complete profile/receipt inventory must be established by root's actual freeze/qualification; file enumeration alone is not executed evidence.
Changing command boundaries creates a new committed profile/subject. Prior full or partial evidence must not be relabeled as this new execution.
